LESSON: GRAMMAR 4.3.1 VERBS AND TENSE

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.3: Grammar 4.3.1 Verbs and Tense

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar 4.3.1 Verbs and Tense. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it necessary to indicate when an activity takes place?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify verbs in the simple present and simple past tense in a text
2. write sentences using the simple present tense
3. write sentences using the simple past tense

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR 4.3.1 VERBS AND TENSE
This lesson teaches Grammar 4.3.1 Verbs and Tense for Grade 7 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify verbs in the simple present and simple past tense in a text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. write sentences using the simple present tense
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. write sentences using the simple past tense
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar 4.3.1 Verbs and Tense using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar 4.3.1 Verbs and Tense above.
2. Explain Grammar 4.3.1 Verbs and Tense to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar 4.3.1 Verbs and Tense.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar 4.3.1 Verbs and Tense with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar 4.3.1 Verbs and Tense important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it necessary to indicate when an activity takes place?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify verbs in the simple present and simple past tense in a text
2. write sentences using the simple present tense
3. write sentences using the simple past tense

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
